title: "Pointblank, GT, and Great Docs: A Tour Across R and Python" 
subtitle: "A tour of Pointblank, GT/Great Tables, and Great Docs across the R and Python ecosystems"
date: '2026-07-21'
description: Ensuring data quality, communicating results with polished tables, and documenting software effectively are three challenges that every life sciences data science team encounters on a regular basis. In this edition of the [R/Pharma](https://rinpharma.com) Hangout sessions, Posit software engineer Rich Iannone joins us for a wide-ranging tour of his open source work across both R and Python. Rich demonstrates `{pointblank}` for data validation, including a compelling new example that applies over 400 CDISC SDTM conformance rules to clinical data and produces a stakeholder-friendly report with drill-down capabilities on failed checks. He also shares the latest developments in `{gt}` and `{great_tables}` alongside his newly released free book on creating effective display tables, and closes with a preview of `{great_docs}` and its embedded Term Show editor, an HTML-based video editor for terminal recordings that promises to transform how we document CLI-based workflows and training materials.
